title: Operator Microflow Kit: composable idempotent admin tasks and safe automation
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build an Operator Microflow Kit (OMK) — a lightweight library and set of conventions to express runbooks as composable, idempotent tasks (microflows) that can be executed from the Admin Console, CLI, or as automated responders in support playbooks. The goal is to replace large ad-hoc scripts with small verified primitives that include safety checks, dry-run mode, permission gating, and structured telemetry so we can automate common ops flows without increasing blast radius.
acceptance_criteria: Microflow spec v1 documented in Confluence with example YAML and SDK usage
CLI command `redwood ops runflow <name>` supports --dry-run and --confirm flags
Each microflow implements idempotency tokens and returns structured result codes for the Console to display
Runflow executions are recorded in the audit log with actor, inputs (redacted), and outcome
Automated test harness can simulate 100 example microflows and assert safe-fallback behavior
